From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: Emily Park <emily@acmeanalytics.com>
Date: 2026-03-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Post-event ROI & attribution discussion — Summit SF 2026

Team — attaching the post-event rollup for Summit SF. High-level summary first: 

- Total event leads captured: 186 (collected via badge scan + demo signups)
- MQL -> SQL conversions: 34 -> 12
- Pipeline influenced (touches where event appears in timeline): $320,400
- Pipeline sourced (first-touch attributed to event): $148,700

Notes: the attached file (summit2026_kpi_rollup.xlsx) contains the per-lead timeline and HubSpot IDs. The demo list (summit_demo_list.csv) maps demo attendees to AEs. I also included the promo deck for reference.

Two asks: 
1) Can Rev/AE review the deals I marked as "event-sourced" and flag any that you believe should be attributed elsewhere? We used a 14-day last-touch lookback for "sourced" in the rollup but we can revisit.
2) We need a final, agreed pipeline number and a short blurb for the marketing SR that goes to finance by EOD Friday.

I'm cc'ing Emily from Acme for transparency — they attended the VIP demo and asked about attribution for their pilot opportunity (DEAL-7421).

Attachments: summit2026_kpi_rollup.xlsx (Excel, 78KB); summit_demo_list.csv (CSV, 24KB); summit_promo_deck.pdf (PDF, 1.1MB)

Thanks — Marissa
Marketing Programs Manager
Redwood Inference
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-03-02T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-event ROI & attribution discussion — Summit SF 2026

Marissa — thanks for the rollup and the ask. I reviewed the list quickly and I think the "sourced" total is overstated by at least $120k. Two quick reasons: 

- Acme Analytics (DEAL-7421) was already in active nurture with AE Parul before the event — HubSpot shows a contact create_date of 2026-02-04 and opportunity open_date of 2026-02-18. The event was a follow-up touch, not the source.
- Nova Systems was a channel-initiated opp; the badge/scan was logged but the origin was our partner program.

I'll drop the specific HubSpot IDs in the sheet, but we need a clear rule: if opportunity creation predates event first-touch, don't mark as sourced. Otherwise we double-count pipeline.

If we keep the 14-day lookback but exclude pre-existing opps, I think the "sourced" number drops by ~$120k. Happy to review the raw lead IDs — please grant RevOps access to the raw export if they're not already in the sheet.

-Aditya
Senior AE, Enterprise Sales
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-03-03T08:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-event ROI & attribution discussion — Summit SF 2026

All — I ran the join between the event lead export and HubSpot. Short data notes below, full sheet at the link: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1EventROI (read-only for now).

Quick numbers I validated: 
- Event leads matched to HubSpot contacts: 162 (24 were duplicates or unmatchable)
- Converted to SQL within 30 days: 18 (of which 8 are currently open opportunities)
- Pipeline influenced (event appears anywhere in contact timeline): $320,400 (matches Marissa's rollup)
- Pipeline sourced (first activity attributed to event within 14-day window): $148,700

Attribution edge-cases I flagged in the sheet: 
- 3 opportunities (including DEAL-7421) have earlier opportunity creation dates — flagged as "pre-event opp". See column H for original create_date.
- 5 leads were courtesy-registrations from partners (tagged partner:yes) — recommend we exclude partner-originated pipeline from marketing-sourced numbers.

Proposal to resolve disputes: 
1) Define "sourced" = first-touch campaign where contact create_date is within X days AFTER the event date; default X=14. 
2) Exclude any opps where opportunity.create_date < event.date from sourced totals (these remain "influenced" if event appears in timeline). 
3) For partner-initiated leads, mark separate line-item in the rollup (keep for transparency, but do not credit marketing budget).

I've attached a snapshot (attr_join_snapshot.png) showing the join logic. If everyone is good with those rules, I'll apply them and produce a final rollup by Thursday noon so Marissa can finalize the finance blurb.

- Tessa
Marketing Operations
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-03-03T14:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-event ROI & attribution discussion — Summit SF 2026

Thanks Tessa — that approach sounds reasonable. Two follow-ups: 

- Please add a column in the sheet with AE owner and "lead first_engaged_by" timestamp so we can see if AEs had active threads prior to the event. I can drop the HubSpot contact IDs into the sheet tonight.
- For partner-originated leads: let's include them in a separate "partner pipeline" bucket and notify Partnerships. If those become SQLs, Partnerships should own the motion and we'll roll to a co-sourced credit discussion.

If Tessa can push the updated rollup by Thursday noon, Marissa can send the finance blurb by EOD Friday. Otherwise we should schedule a quick 30-min sync to finalize. I can be available 10–11am Thursday.

-Aditya
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-03-04T16:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-event ROI & attribution discussion — Summit SF 2026

Appreciate the quick work here. Condensed next steps so we have an exec-ready outcome: 

1) Tessa: implement the three-rule approach (14-day post-event create_date for "sourced", exclude pre-event opps from sourced, partner bucket) and publish final rollup by Thu 2026-03-05 12:00 PDT.
2) Aditya: populate AE owner/contact IDs and flag any additional pre-event threads (tonight).
3) Marissa: prepare the finance blurb and the one-paragraph summary for leadership once Tessa's final rollup is posted — deadline Fri 2026-03-06 EOD.

If we still have disputes after the final rollup, escalate to RevOps for an authoritative tie-break and we will accept their reconciliation. Let's avoid retroactive credits unless RevOps confirms a process exception.

Schedule: I'll block 30 min Thursday 10:00–10:30 to review if needed. Otherwise proceed as agreed.

Vivek
VP, Revenue Operations (interim)
Redwood Inference
